card.name: Linking words before pension and benefits
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'no' and similar small words in lists of worker rights (wages, job protections, benefits) just before a word like pension or benefits is expected. Seen in text on unions, labor laws and minimum wage.

modes.label: Lists of worker perks
modes.description: A comma or 'and' inside a list of wages, benefits and job protections, right before pension or benefits.
modes.example: unionized workers are still far more likely than non-unionized workers to receive health benefits, a pension,<< and>> paid days off.

modes.label: Labor rights and wages
modes.description: A small word in talk of labor laws or living wages, where employment protections come next.
modes.example: 90% of the work force is in the unorganized sector with<< no>> labour laws guiding their employment rights.

card.writes: It makes pension, retirement and benefits words more likely as the next word, and programming words less likely.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in union and worker-rights text when a pension or benefits term is likely next.
